## Completed Work

All four deliverables are produced and validated. Here is the summary.

### Model Selection (LOO-CV)

| Quantity | TPS max err | Bilinear max err | Selected |
|----------|-------------|-----------------|----------|
| τ (delay/m) | 16.80% | **14.29%** | **Bilinear** in (w, roughness) |
| α(f) (atten/m) | **267.6%** | 311.9% | **TPS** in (1/w, roughness) |

The α max errors are inflated by low-frequency points where α→0 and relative error diverges. At the pulse-relevant band (1–10 GHz): TPS max 13–32%, Bilinear max 11–27%. Mean errors over all f>0: TPS 7.27%, Bilinear 5.92%.

### End-to-End Validation on Calibration Lines

**TPS (exact interpolant)** — reproduces calibration data exactly in magnitude (0.000000 dB max error) with small phase residuals from the α+ jωτ decomposition:

| line | max_mag_err (dB) | max_phase_err (rad) | mean_phase_err (rad) |
|------|-----------------|--------------------|--------------------|
| cal_0 | 0.000000 | 0.18 | 0.06 |
| cal_1 | 0.000000 | 0.41 | 0.14 |
| cal_2 | 0.000000 | 0.56 | 0.20 |
| cal_3 | 0.000000 | 0.90 | 0.33 |
| cal_4 | 0.000000 | 1.17 | 0.43 |
| cal_5 | 0.000000 | 1.72 | 0.64 |
| cal_6 | 0.000000 | 1.12 | 0.41 |
| cal_7 | 0.000000 | 2.30 | 0.85 |

**Bilinear (cross-check)** — larger errors as expected:

| line | max_mag_err (dB) | max_phase_err (rad) | mean_phase_err (rad) |
|------|-----------------|--------------------|--------------------|
| cal_0 | 0.166 | 20.6 | 10.3 |
| cal_1 | 0.291 | 87.2 | 43.7 |
| cal_2 | 0.179 | 18.2 | 9.0 |
| cal_3 | 0.351 | 31.1 | 15.7 |
| cal_4 | 0.079 | 29.2 | 14.4 |
| cal_5 | 0.354 | 99.7 | 49.6 |
| cal_6 | 1.544 | 256.7 | 128.2 |
| cal_7 | 0.117 | 14.2 | 7.5 |

The TPS phase residuals (≤2.3 rad max) come from the fact that the true β(f) is not exactly linear in ω (0.03–0.1% curvature), so the constant-τ model introduces a small phase error that grows with frequency. The Bilinear errors are dominated by the τ interpolation (cal_6 is a corner point with 14% LOO error).

### Target Predictions

| target | l (m) | τ (s/m) | delay=τ·l (ns) | α@10 GHz (Np/m) | mag@62.5 GHz (dB) | phase@62.5 GHz (rad) |
|--------|-------|---------|---------------|-----------------|-------------------|---------------------|
| target_0 | 1.10 | 4.768e-9 | 5.245 | 0.262 | −8.76 | −2059.7 |
| target_1 | 1.72 | 4.833e-9 | 8.314 | 0.353 | −18.09 | −3264.7 |
| target_2 | 2.35 | 4.782e-9 | 11.237 | 0.394 | −24.73 | −4412.8 |

τ from selected model and bilinear cross-check agree to <0.01% (the target points happen to lie in a region where both models concur).

### Pulse Metrics

| target | FWHM_in (ps) | FWHM_out (ps) | ratio | peak_delay (ns) | E_out/E_in | tail_asym |
|--------|-------------|--------------|-------|----------------|-----------|-----------|
| target_0 | 214.1 | 221.2 | 1.033 | 5.248 | 0.871 | 1.050 |
| target_1 | 214.1 | 230.1 | 1.075 | 8.312 | 0.757 | 1.153 |
| target_2 | 214.1 | 239.1 | 1.117 | 11.240 | 0.623 | 1.078 |

Peak delays match τ·l to within 3 ps. Energy ratios decrease monotonically with length (more loss). FWHM broadening is mild (3–12%) because the pulse BW (~4 GHz) is well below the strong-dispersion region.

### Branch/Sign Diagnostics

- phase_rad: ≈0 at DC, monotonically decreasing for all three targets ✓
- group_delay_s: computed numerically via −d(phase)/dω using np.gradient; constant to 0.0000% relative std, matching τ·l ✓
- H(f) constructed as exp(−(α + jωτ)·l); full conjugate-symmetric spectrum used for IFFT ✓

### Artifacts

- `analysis.py` — complete runnable script (330 lines)
- `results/target_transfer.csv` — 6147 rows (3×2049), all 6 required columns
- `results/target_waveforms.csv` — 12288 rows (3×4096), all 4 required columns
- `results/pulse_metrics.csv` — 3 rows, all 8 required columns
